name: Mystic Sight
description: a creature sees death coming and can foretell the manner of a person's death. This ability does not come with any urge to share that information. Gypsosphinxes are notorious for hinting, teasing, and even lying about a creature's death ('If we fight, I will kill you and eat your heart. I have seen it', is a favorite bluff).
